item.title: DIANE MARIE HEERMANN
item.description: Diane Marie Heermann, 65, a resident of Grain Valley, MO, passed away peacefully Wednesday, January 28, 2026, at her home surrounded by her husband and daughters after a strong and courageous nearly 3-year battle with pancreatic cancer.

item.title: BOONVILLE R-1 SCHOOLS ANNOUNCES APPOINTMENT OF ITS NEXT SUPERINTENDENT
item.description: The Boonville R-1 School District didn’t have to look very far to find its next Superintendent, with the Board of Education appointing current High School Principal Dr. Brent Hodge to that role for the 2026-2027 school year.
